_doc: Per-network fork config, read by script/utils/resolve-fork.sh (rpcUrlEnv, block) and test/BaseForkTest.t.sol (registry). Select one with `make fork-test NETWORK=<key>`; the key also names the config/<key>/ directory holding that network's deny-list and batcher files. `block` null (the default) forks latest - 50; a positive integer pins a run, and FORK_BLOCK overrides it.
